results.name: universal_word_singleton_rating
results.description: Mean Likert rating of a probed visual singleton when the heard word is true of all objects in the scene and distractors are duplicated; tests under-prediction from M-implicature penalty.

results.name: asymmetric_5object_contrast_gap
results.description: Difference in mean Likert rating between minimal target and duplicate competitor in 5-object asymmetric displays; tests under-production of pragmatic contrast in large scenes.

results.name: scalar_competitor_unique_feature_rating
results.description: Mean Likert rating of a probed scalar competitor possessing an unmentioned unique feature when distractors sharing the heard word are duplicated; tests spurious singleton prior preservation.

results.name: redundant_multifeature_competitor_rating
results.description: Mean Likert rating of a probed scalar competitor with redundant features when a minimal referent exists; tests lack of feature parsimony on informative trials.

results.name: maximal_referent_duplicate_distractors_rating
results.description: Mean Likert rating of a probed maximal referent when distractors sharing the heard word are duplicated minimal objects; tests under-prediction of maximal referent in duplicate scenes.

results.name: scalar_implicature_minimal_vs_maximal_gap
results.description: Difference in mean Likert rating between minimal referent and maximal competitor in 4-object scalar implicature scenes; tests over-polarization of scalar implicatures.

results.name: prior_singleton_rating
results.description: Mean Likert rating of a probed visual singleton on uninformative prior trials with no word heard; tests over-confidence of singleton prior in continuous likelihood ratings.

results.name: high_ambiguity_informative_rating
results.description: Mean Likert rating across informative trials where the heard word is true of 4 or more objects; tests under-prediction of candidate likelihood under broad referential ambiguity.
